## What's free

Personal plan: 3 users, 100 devices

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://tailscale.com/pricing> before relying on this.

## Notes

Hosts can already join a tailnet on first boot (tailscale_auth_key in the shared bootstrap). This stack will manage ACLs and auth keys.

## Plan

- `stack/`: a root module that reads the hybrid inventory (`hybrid/` state) and wires every host (DNS records, mesh ACLs, tunnels)
